_comment: WFAIA AIアニメ部門『はしっこビルの明日づくり』コンセプトフィルム（約70秒・16:9）のショット表。start_frame は I2V の開始フレーム。single キャラは 2:3 スチルを 16:9 に左右アウトペイント（Floyo内 or Higgsfield outpaint）して使う。
i2v_style_suffix: Handcrafted stop-motion puppet animation, shot on twos at 12fps with subtle frame-to-frame armature jitter, fabric and felt texture preserved, practical miniature set lighting, film grain, static camera unless specified. Keep the exact puppet design from the start frame — no morphing, no redesign, no added facial features.

shots.start_frame: GENERATED — generated.json の wfaia_fog_169 を参照
shots.motion: Dense fog drifts slowly. One by one, from the bottom upward, the eight colored glows breathe into existence, each flickering softly like a practical bulb warming up. Camera locked.

The caretaker puppet slowly raises the cluster of glowing bulbs a few centimeters; their warm light blooms and gently sways, casting moving shadows on his robe. His head tilts down toward the light. Camera pushes in very slowly.
The black-robed puppet stands almost still; the small bell at her collar swings once and settles. The red tassel of her ledger sways. Hem of the robe shifts as if breathing. Camera locked.
The gears on the toymaker puppet's apron begin to turn slowly, one after another; his goggle eyes rotate to focus. One mechanical claw hand opens and closes once. Camera locked.
The accountant puppet lifts the deep-red ledger slightly and taps it twice with his pen. The flame-like black hair flickers as if in a draft. His stitched smile stays fixed. Camera locked.
The brass instruments hanging on the meteorologist puppet's cream coat swing and clink gently as she turns her head; a small gauge needle spins. Camera pushes in slowly.
A thin wisp of pale vapor rises from the spout of the perfumer puppet's cylindrical head; the glass bottles on its chest glint as it slowly raises one dark hand. Camera locked.

shots.start_frame: f6_kurogane v3 (7de3b8e2) — 単体。大和カットは a09
shots.motion: The printing-press puppet pulls his long lever arm down once; the press bed slides and a sheet of paper feeds through. Paper-strip beard sways with the motion. Camera locked.
The slender puppet's long black hair streams slowly in a draft; she looks down at her own fingertips, then back up, utterly expressionless. Camera pushes in very slowly.

The small girl puppet runs in place lifting her knees high, the tower of trunks overhead swaying precariously left and right but never falling; her twin ponytails bounce. Slight camera shake as if handheld miniature rig.

shots.motion: The girl puppet places the small wooden lunch box into the printer puppet's ink-black fingers; both hold still for a beat; the warm orange and proof-red glows brighten together. Camera locked.
All eight colored glows now burn steadily together; the fog thins just slightly, hinting at warmth, then the lights hold. Fade to black at the end. Camera locked.
